name: mixxx
description: Runs Mixxx controller mappings (.midi.xml with their JavaScript files) from your Mixxx folders on a MIDI port.

settings.label: Mapping folder
settings.help: a folder with .midi.xml files and their scripts, searched before the usual Mixxx folders (~/.mixxx/controllers, /usr/share/mixxx/controllers, …)

settings.label: Mapping
settings.help: part of a mapping's name or file name to use on a port you assigned to this plugin when no mapping matches its name
